thread:
incident-bot: Pager duty: high error rate detected on prod-edge (gateway 5xx surge) — triggered at 2024-10-25 03:13:09 UTC. Alerts: 5xx rate > 6% for 2m. @oncall-alex paging now.

oncall-alex: seeing ~8% 502/504s from edge -> upstream TLS handshake failures. Good morning/afternoon folks. Jumping in.

sre-maria: I can help — looks correlated to cert validation errors in the proxy logs. Pulling latest logs.

eng-runtime-tyler: I just saw lots of: `tls: received alert certificate_unknown` in sidecar logs. Could be OCSP or intermediate chain.

security-rahul: any recent cert rotations? KMS logs?

oncall-alex: no scheduled rotations in last 48h. No deploys to edge in the last 30m per deploy-bot.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20241025-022. Severity: P1. Channels: incidents, eng-runtime, eng-sre.

custsuccess-jade: Support queue seeing spike in errors for several enterprise customers — some calls from EU customers at 03:10 UTC. CS is triaging.

eng-runtime-tyler: dumping a few error lines from a failing connection:
``` 
2024-10-25T03:11:58Z proxy[edge-34]: error: tls handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2024-10-25T03:12:01Z proxy[edge-37]: verify error: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
```

sre-maria: interestingly, upstream OCSP stapling responses look delayed/504 from our OCSP relays. Could be OCSP responder flapping.

security-rahul: checking CA chain — our private mTLS CA shows leaf cert expiry at 2024-10-26 02:59 UTC for one rotated bundle? wait.. older leaf was rotated on 2024-10-24 01:00 but there is a secondary legacy cert still present.

oncall-alex: hypothesis: some proxies pulled the new bundle that removed OCSP stapling or included an incomplete chain, causing intermittent verification failures for mutual TLS. Need to confirm which nodes are hitting which cert bundle.

eng-runtime-tyler: running this query on config store: `SELECT node, cert_bundle_id FROM edge_nodes WHERE last_sync > now() - interval '1 day';` Got mixed bundles: bundle_v20241024 and bundle_v20240901 still active on ~12% of nodes.

incident-bot: paging oncall for cert-rotation team @security-rahul.

security-rahul: confirmed — some older nodes failed to fetch the newest bundle due to S3 List permission error during the bundle push window. Push succeeded for majority but 23 nodes timed out and kept serving legacy chain. That explains partial impact.

sre-maria: can we temporarily route traffic away from the 23 nodes while we force a re-sync? Rolling restart or remove from LB?

eng-runtime-tyler: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) mark the 23 nodes as draining in the load balancer (takes effect instantly). 2) trigger config re-sync + restart agent on those nodes. 3) if errors persist, fallback to the previous compatible bundle on the control plane to avoid mixed-chain states.

oncall-alex: Do 1+2 now. I'll coordinate with infra. Oncall-handoff to infra to drain nodes.

custsuccess-jade: informing affected customers: message drafted: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors related to TLS certificate validation at the edge; engineers are mitigating now. No data loss. We will provide ETA in 15 minutes." Approve? :eyes:

eng-runtime-tyler: approve. Add note about potential retrying clients may observe transient failures.

eng-runtime-tyler: running drain command for nodes:
```
# drain nodes that report legacy bundle
for n in $(cat legacy_nodes.txt); do lbctl drain $n --reason "cert-bundle-mismatch"; done
```

sre-maria: starting agent re-sync on drained nodes: `systemctl restart edge-config-agent` and monitoring cert_bundle_id update.

incident-bot: automated action: LB removed 23 nodes from active pool. Healthcheck reroute in progress.

~2m later~

eng-runtime-tyler: re-sync logs show all 23 nodes pulled bundle_v20241024 successfully now. cert_bundle_id updated.

sre-maria: rolling healthchecks back to normal. Observed 5xx rate drop from 8% -> 1.6% across the fleet in the last 3m. Still seeing isolated timeouts to OCSP relays.

security-rahul: I'm initiating a fast follow: re-enable OCSP caching TTL bump and add fallback stapling for clients that don't require stapled responses. Patching config now.

eng-runtime-tyler: patch applied to OCSP relays to extend cache and add aggressive retry. Logs show fewer OCSP 504s.

custsuccess-jade: CS update sent to customers. Early response: a few customers confirm reduced errors.

oncall-alex: good. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. We should schedule a post-incident action: 1) fix S3 permission race for bundle push, 2) ensure LB draining automated when bundle mismatch detected, 3) add metric alert for mixed cert bundle percent > 5%.

incident-bot: Action items recorded: INC-20241025-022-A1 (S3 publish permission fix), A2 (auto-drain on mismatch), A3 (alert for mixed_bundle_percent). Owner assignments pending.

eng-runtime-tyler: brief troubleshooting note to include in postmortem: mixed bundle state + OCSP relay latency amplified impact -> caused mutual TLS validation errors and gateway 5xx.

sre-maria: handoff to night oncall: @oncall-alex -> @oncall-nikhil in 15m. Current status: degraded -> recovering. Error rate stable ~0.8% for last 5m.

oncall-alex: handing off. Monitors to watch: edge_5xx_rate, ocsp_504_rate, mixed_bundle_percent. If >2% 5xx or mixed_bundle_percent >3% re-escalate to eng-runtime and security.

security-rahul: I'll own the S3 permission fix; will follow up with a changelist and runbook for bundle publishes.

custsuccess-jade: I'll close open tickets once we hold stable for 30m and customers confirm.

incident-bot: Incident state updated: Mitigated, monitoring. Next update due in 30m or on significant change.

oncall-alex: thanks, team. Nice quick mitigation.

sre-maria: adding one quick note — please include `edge_node_cert_bundle_id` in our per-request logs for future correlation (low overhead). I'll add to followups.

eng-runtime-tyler: will add to A1/A2 tasks.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from oncall-alex, :white_check_mark: from custsuccess-jade)
